# MedPoint Partners

> Healthcare finance and revenue cycle recruiting firm in Atlanta, GA, powered by NorthPoint. MedPoint Partners helps hospitals, physician groups, and healthcare organizations hire finance and revenue cycle professionals through direct hire, contract and interim staffing, retained search, contract-to-hire, and RPO, and acts as Employer of Record for contract placements.

## Contact
- Phone: 404-250-0790 or 678-777-5627
- Email: gus@stafffinancial.com
- Location: Atlanta, GA. Serves the Southeast; many revenue cycle and coding searches run nationwide (remote).
- Request talent: https://www.medpointpartners.com/request-talent.html
- Job board: https://host.pcrecruiter.net/pcrbin/jobboard.aspx?uid=Staff%20Financial.npsg

## Roles placed
- Finance leadership: CFO, VP of Finance, Controller, Assistant Controller, Accounting Manager, Senior and Staff Accountant, healthcare payroll
- Revenue cycle: VP / Director of Revenue Cycle, Patient Financial Services Director, Revenue Integrity, Billing and A/R, denials and appeals, patient access
- Coding and CDI: Coding Manager / HIM Director, inpatient and outpatient coders (CCS, CPC), pro-fee and specialty coders, CDI specialists (CCDS, CDIP), coding auditors, charge capture and CDM analysts
- Reimbursement, analytics and practice operations: reimbursement and cost report analysts, managed care contracting, healthcare FP&A and decision support, practice administrators, precertification and prior authorization, credentialing and payer enrollment

## Healthcare settings served
Hospitals and health systems; physician groups and specialty practices; orthopedic and spine practices; ambulatory surgery centers; home health and hospice; behavioral health; senior living and post-acute; labs, imaging and diagnostics; RCM and billing companies; payers and health plans; PE-backed platforms and MSOs; community health centers and FQHCs.

## How it works
- Blinded shortlist of pre-screened candidates in 48 to 72 hours.
- Custom screening questionnaire for every search; each résumé arrives with the candidate's answers.
- Optional candidate video introductions.
- Direct hire is contingency (fee on placement) with a replacement guarantee. Retained search is paid in installments with a full replacement guarantee. Contract is billed hourly with MedPoint as Employer of Record (weekly payroll, taxes, workers' comp, W-2).
- Reach: more than 3 million résumés and a private network of over 15 million profiles; 105+ years of combined recruiting experience.
